scientific_integrity: The asserted contribution is an exact parameter classification derived from a direct invariant-subspace proof; finite checks corroborate the identities, not the universal quantifiers. General normalized-Laplacian transfer criteria and ordinary-Laplacian join theory are attributed to their sources.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is for unit-weight undirected regular bases and symmetric normalized Laplacian, between the two apexes. No assertion is made for irregular or weighted bases, other transfer pairs, or decoherence. General eigenvalue phase criteria are pre-existing; new parameter-specific theorem remains subject to literature-indexing risk.
title: Exact two-adic criterion for normalized-Laplacian transfer on regular double cones
